Epic 6
- Story 6.2: The launcher runs "the newest runner version any lane on the host pins", but runner versions are free-form names (Xarabot's `runner-14`, a consumer's npm pin such as `0.3.0`), so "newest" has no defined order. Readings: (a) semver order: `runner-14` does not parse and needs its own rule; (b) the most recently installed `~/.xarabot/runner/<version>/`: after a pin-back, an older runner counts as newest; (c) a name order with numbers compared as numbers: ranks `runner-14` against `0.3.0` arbitrarily.
- Story 6.4: Is `xarabot report` one figure for the whole host or one per repo? Readings: (a) host-wide: merged Stories from every repo on the host, with hours left out only when every builder of every repo waits on the Maintainer; (b) per repo: each repo's merged Stories over its own builders' spans, which gives the SPEC's "Xaravel work" figure on a host that also runs Xarabot's lanes.
- Story 6.4: Merged Stories are read from the forge, but no Forge read lists PRs merged in a period, and 6.4's manifest globs leave out `src/ports/**`, `src/adapters/forge/**` and `test/contracts/**`, so the write check refuses the read. Readings: (a) a graph unit widens 6.4's globs, and 6.4 adds the read to the port, both forges and the contract suite; (b) a new forge Story adds the read, and 6.4 depends on it.
Epic 5 has no open questions. Sprint planning: gate CONCERNS, only the three points above; sprint-status.yaml is valid and unchanged. The script would rename `3-2-the-pi-adapter` to `3-2-the-pi-adapter-deferred-to-v1` from the retitled heading, but `stories/3.2.md` pins `sprint_key: 3-2-the-pi-adapter`, so the existing key was kept and nothing was written. No context file was compiled.
